sources.name: Lenis
sources.role: Smooths native scrolling; synchronizes scroll position with GSAP or WebGL. Does not create animation timelines itself.

sources.name: Barba.js

implementationGuidance: GSAP, Lenis and Barba are complementary: animation engine, scroll smoothing and navigation lifecycle. Use only the layers needed.
CSS sticky and native overflow can produce excellent pinned stories and horizontal galleries without a library.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion and offer pause controls for continuous decorations; current Lenis includes respectReducedMotion enabled by default.
Animate transforms and opacity where possible. Large blur layers, WebGL, videos and image sequences dominate GPU, memory and bandwidth costs.
Refresh measurements after responsive changes and late-loading media. Tear down ScrollTriggers and animation loops on route changes.
Test keyboard access, touch scrolling, anchor navigation, focus and history. Never make content depend on animation finishing.
